beats.narration: The cumulative task hides three defects in one runnable application — one per layer of this module. If you haven't found and fixed all three, pause. Everything from here is spoilers.

Defect one, the security layer, and it's the loudest: the write destination comes from the page's suggested path — a destination chosen by untrusted fetched content. That's prompt injection holding the pen. The fix: a fixed output path, with a pre-tool-use hook enforcing the boundary and logging the attempt.

elements.text:
the PAGE picks where the agent writes —
injection with a pen

beats.narration: Defect two, the failure layer: the retry loop sleeps for zero seconds and catches everything. No backoff, so each instant retry deepens a rate limit. No terminal detection, so a bad request burns all five attempts failing identically. The fix is the corrected loop from the checkpoint: honor retry-after, back off exponentially with a cap, and fail fast on terminal statuses.

elements.code:
except Exception:     # ✗ retries terminal too
    time.sleep(0)     # ✗ instant hammer

elements.text: ✓ retry-after → capped backoff → terminal fails fast

beats.narration: Defect three is the quiet one, because it isn't in the code — it's missing from it. No eval exists. Success was judged by a few manual runs, so nothing fails when a prompt or model change regresses the feature. The fix: a graded holdout set that runs on every change, giving the module's first layer the last word.

elements.text:
the defect is an ABSENCE —
no graded set anywhere
"a few manual runs" = nothing fails on regression
✓ graded holdout set, run on every change

beats.narration: Three defects, and the module in miniature: the boundary enforced, the failure sorted, the success measured. If you caught all three, you're reading code the way production reads it. Next: the module's key takeaways.
